says: A repository's Instructions position selects its review rule for the concern review.approval, required at startup, and declares that the rule relies on the Team's terms unit; the Team's position selects its own review rule for the same concern and its terms, and a second Team source switched off. Composing for the repository session from both positions, the repository's review rule wins, so the Team's review rule is shadowed and its shadowed_by names that winning unit; the Team's terms unit stays in the preparation with needed_by naming the same winning unit; the switched-off source's unit is disabled. Every shadowed_by and needed_by in the preparation the owner writes names a unit of that preparation that won - never the layered background note, the terms unit itself or the disabled unit - which is what the rule C07/unit_reference_names_a_winning_unit holds and its fixture's breaking records violate.
